nodes.label: Use Cursor-Based Pagination Instead of OFFSET
nodes.rationale: Impact MEDIUM-HIGH, O(1) regardless of depth: OFFSET must scan and discard every skipped row, so page 10000 scans 200k rows. Keyset pagination (WHERE id > last_id ORDER BY id LIMIT 20) uses the index and costs the same at any depth; with multi-column sorts the cursor must carry every sort column as a row comparison.
